key_insight: A curvilinear D3Q27 cumulant lattice-Boltzmann method retains exact one-to-one streaming on a uniform computational lattice while representing smoothly warped physical grids through local geometry.
engineering_relevance: The approach supports complex-grid flow simulation and moving-boundary fluid–structure interaction without interpolation-based advection.
method: Encode local geometry with a metric-Gaussian equilibrium and a Christoffel-connection source in moment space.
Dynamically reconstruct homogeneous-state perturbations to preserve uniform physical flow on warped meshes.
Use D3Q27 cumulant collision with boundary-compatible ALE and two-way FSI extensions.
evidence_signal: Warped-grid shear-wave, Taylor–Green, ABC-flow, Poiseuille, peristaltic-pumping, and FSI tests assess flow dynamics and boundary coupling; tested warped periodic cases conserve global mass and momentum to round-off accuracy.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish robustness limits for severe grid deformation or quantify computational overhead.
paper_title: Local Metrics for Exact Streaming on Curvilinear Lattices: A Curvilinear D3Q27 Cumulant Lattice-Boltzmann Method
